summary: Row 3 ('Wacky Quacker Cooks His Own Goose' / 26歳のアヒルパンツさぁー!, 2003-11-22) IS exactly anchorable and gets an anchor: END 3 / START 2 / vol 1. The episode plays ch 3 'Hajike Festival' first (Bo-bobo and Beauty arriving at Hajike Village dragging the giant burger, the Dynamite Bros. and the Wig-Out Festival) and then goes on to ch 2 'Pervert' (Kilalino the Hair Hunt assassin and his 26-year-old duck underwear 'Takashi', whom the episode is named after) — an INTERNAL reversal on top of the ep 2/3 block reversal batch 17 already recorded. Three independent lines pin it: bobobo.fandom's Kilalino-and-Takashi infobox reads Debut (Manga) Chapter 2 / Debut (Anime) Episode 3; the fandom's ch-3 page ('Hajike Festival (Chapter)') and en.wikipedia's ep-3 synopsis describe the same beats in the same order (giant burger costume, then the Dynamite Bros., then the duck-underwear Hair Hunter); and the neighbours close the span exactly — ep 2 holds ch 4-5, ep 4 opens at ch 6. Because ep 2 already ran ahead to ch 4-5, this is a backwards END and the position lattice needs two explicit parity continue points (ep 2 → ch 2, ep 3 → ch 6), otherwise a derived END+1 after ep 3 would send a reader back to ch 4, which they have already seen. This resolves batch 17's deliberate non-anchor on ep 3.

('26-Year-Old Duck Underwear') is Takashi, listed as age 26 on that infobox. Span closure: ch 1 = ep 1, ch 4-5 = ep 2 (stored), ch 6 = ep 4's START (stored).

flags_for_sean: EP 3 IS A DELIBERATE BACKWARDS ANCHOR. Batch 17 withheld it precisely to avoid one ('anchoring it would put a backwards END into the series'). I am proposing it because the evidence is exact and because the catalog already accepts backwards ENDs in rearranged zones when parity continue points carry the position (ranma eps 22/23/26/28/125 under A18). If Sean prefers the batch-17 posture, the fallback is: no anchor on ep 3, but STILL take the two continue points above — the ep-2 → ch 2 continue is needed either way, or chs 2-3 are never handed to the reader.

The ep-3 anchor's start_chapter 2 slightly overlaps ep 1's stored graft (ch 2's opening block-leaders' conference cold-opens ep 1). That overlap is annotation-only and does not move ep 1's END (1) — chapter overlap never proves anything about typing or position by itself.

Confidence note: this is a gag series with no published per-episode chapter map anywhere, so 'high' here means five artefacts agreeing on chapter IDENTITY (an infobox debut pair, an episode-title-to-character identity, two content matches, and both neighbours closing the span), not a quoted mapping. It is materially better evidenced than the surrounding medium-confidence eps 1-4 anchors, which I did not re-open.
